name: Goutam Jena/ଗୌତମ ଜେନା

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Goutam Jena’s ‘ସ୍ମିତହସ’, published in Kabita Live’s February 2024 edition, begins with a simple smile free of mockery or pretence. The poem gradually opens that image to many interpretations, comparing its power to connect feelings with a bridge across a river.

Light and shadow, retreating waves and a bird’s wings give that inquiry a changing landscape. Later passages question pride, self-deception and the difficulty of finding truth. The smile survives these doubts as something still fresh and elusive, renewing the poem’s search rather than settling it.
